sentences.text: 2. Mr. Samir Mangaonkar, learned APP for the Respondent-State  seeks time to take instructions in this matter.
3. Prima facie it appears to be a case of civil dispute, the gravamen of  the dispute appears to be the possession of the property.
In any  event, the entire dispute revolves around documentary evidence.

4. In the meantime, the following interim Order is passed:
 ORDER i.

In event of arrest of the Applicant in connection with offence registered under Sections 420, 406,
465, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) vide F.I.R. No.619 of 2025 dated 14/11/2025, the Applicant be released on executing PR bond of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties of the like amount.
ii. The Applicant shall attend the Virar Police Station- Respondent on 07/01/2026 to 09/01/2026 from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. and co-operate with the agency.
iii. The Applicant shall not tamper with the witnesses in any manner.
5. To enable to learned A.P.P. to take instructions, list the matter on 14th January, 2026 for further consideration.

(SANDESH D. PATIL, J.)
